title: gauravkp/brbseq pipeline - samplesheet schema
description: One row per pooled/multiplexed sequencing run (NOT one row per biological sample - BRB-seq pools many samples per run via in-read barcoding). Sample names declared inside each run's barcode_map must be unique across the whole samplesheet.

run.errorMessage: Run identifier must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: FASTQ file for Read 1 (sample barcode + UMI) must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FASTQ file for Read 2 (cDNA fragment) must be provided, cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

barcode_map.errorMessage: A barcode_map file (CSV/TSV mapping sample names to barcodes used in this run) must be provided
